title: At accept, next's review guidance stales verification in a commit-first project, so the ship is refused
symptom: Following rule 6 (open the review gate, close it with checkpoint --close-gate --verdict pass, then change ship) writes .chough/ between change check --commit and finalize; SpecSync then refuses finalize and chough change ship as stale verification
trigger: A project whose sdd.json does not leave Chough's records out of verification, the default after specsync change adopt, at accept while verifying
expected: next points at the ship that writes nothing under .chough/ until after the native ship (REQ-cli-059, REQ-records-014)
actual: Rule 6 names checkpoint --close-gate with the verdict before the ship
environment: local-macos-arm64, tester build at 596ced67, debug, SpecSync 6.3.0
impact: A human's decision to ship is refused in commit-first projects

notes.text: status: open -> investigating. Red at caf49681 (before its fix, SpecSync 6.3.0 on PATH): rule 6 named checkpoint --close-gate before the ship; fix in 9c2ca469.
status: investigating -> verified. Green at 4efba39f: TC-cli-accept-ships-through-change-ship passed; next, relay, stages, gates, humans, change and docs tests pass.
